'''Emissary''' was a title used by some [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]. One [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reborn Sith Empire]] before the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> while [[Nathanjo Nirrelz]] served as an Emissary for the [[Gotal Foreign Affairs Commune]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_4.html|Gotal Guerillas Hijack Commuter Hopper, Take Hostages}}</ref>
